name: Elite Woodworking
old_description: At Elite Woodworking our devotion is to the finest craftsmanship of custom cabinet doors and drawer fronts. Imagination takes form as the designer's ideas are brought to life by the hands of our skilled artisans. We believe your dreams define the quality of our products regardless of personal style and taste. Elite Woodworking emphasizes the unparalleled beauty and elegance of natural wood design choices for every room in your home. Your custom designs, combined with our artistic visions create beautiful kitchens, bathrooms and other areas of your home.
about:
Elite Woodworking was founded in 1990 in Phoenix, Arizona, by Dan Walker after he completed an apprenticeship at Wilson Custom Cabinets in 1982 and worked two additional years at a small custom cabinet shop. The company remains family-owned and operates from its Melinda Lane facility, which it has occupied since 1999.

The shop manufactures custom cabinet doors and drawer fronts in a wide range of styles — including cope-and-stick, mitered, French light, and carved designs — as well as mouldings and hardware. With a team of about 10 skilled craftsmen, Elite Woodworking produces doors to exact customer specifications for kitchens, bathrooms, and other residential spaces.

The company serves over 100 cabinet makers and private individuals throughout Arizona, supplying both trade professionals and homeowners directly. Its products appear in custom cabinetry projects across the region, from high-end residential kitchens to Habitat for Humanity builds, which the company supports.

Elite Woodworking emphasizes eco-friendly lumber options and a mission to meet precise size and style requirements while delivering the highest quality of craftsmanship. The founder’s original vision — combining the designer’s imagination with the artisan’s skill — continues to guide the business.
